dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a new pair of shoes. I'm interested in something rugged, stylish, and comfortable. I'm willing to spend between $100 and $200. Do you have any recommendations?
dialogue.agent:
I found a few options that match your criteria:

1. **"Under Armour Men's HOVR Sonic 6 Running Shoe"**
   - Price: $110.00
   - Average Rating: 4.7/5
   - Number of Reviews: 7
   - Description: Built insanely light and supportive so nothing will hold you back the second coach blows that whistle. Paired with soft, springy UA HOVR™ cushioning that pushes you forward—you'll crush those run drills.

2. **"OLUKAI Kipuka Hulu Men's Leather Slippers, Premium Nubuck Leather Slip On Shoes, Shearling Lining & Gel Insert, Drop-In Heel Design"**
   - Price: $130.00
   - Average Rating: 4.7/5
   - Number of Reviews: 174
   - Description: Leather Upper-Rubber Outsole

3. **"Cole Haan Men's Grnd Plus Essex Wedgechukka Chukka Boot"**
   - Price: $129.59
   - Average Rating: 4.6/5
   - Number of Reviews: 35
   - Description: Cole Haan was founded on the principles of providing elegantly innovative footwear, resulting in sophisticated shoes with a sneaker-like feel. This pair of chukka boots is no exception and has been expertly crafted in a ruggedly handsome materials that pair just as well with chinos and a sweater for work or denim and a flannel on the weekend.

Would you like more details on any of these options?

products.title: Under Armour Men's HOVR Sonic 6 Running Shoe
products.description: Built insanely light and supportive so nothing will hold you back the second coach blows that whistle. Paired with soft, springy UA HOVR™ cushioning that pushes you forward—you'll crush those run drills., Engineered mesh upper with seamless forefoot for comfort & breathability. External heel counter for lightweight structure & added lockdown. 3D-molded sockliner cradles the foot for enhanced step-in comfort. Responsive UA HOVR™ cushioning reduces impact, returns energy & helps propel you forward. Combination of carbon rubber & blown rubber in the outsole for strategic durability & lightweight rebound, Updated outsole design has flexibility where you need it & disperses impact efficiently for a smooth ride. Offset: 8mm. Weight: 9.9 oz.. Lace type: Standard tie. NEUTRAL: For runners who need a balance of flexibility & cushioning. .

Cole Haan Men's Grnd Plus Essex Wedgechukka Chukka Boot
products.description: Cole Haan was founded on the principles of providing elegantly innovative footwear, resulting in sophisticated shoes with a sneaker-like feel. This pair of chukka boots is no exception and has been expertly crafted in a ruggedly handsome materials that pair just as well with chinos and a sweater for work or denim and a flannel on the weekend. Built with our grand's technology in the outsole for all-day comfort and energy return. With nearly 80 years in the business and hundreds of points of distribution in the U.S., Cole Haan is one of America's premier luxury brands. Founded in 1928 as a collaboration between Trafton Cole and Eddie Haan, Cole Haan epitomized artisan quality and impeccable craftsmanship during a time when style was everything. Originally, Cole Haan was a men's footwear label that captured the essence of the 20s spirit with beautifully-designed and well-made shoes for the dapper gentleman. Today, Cole Haan brings that heritage to all of its products, including men's and women's dress and casual footwear, belts, hosiery, handbags, small leather goods, outerwear and sunglasses.

dialogue.user: Those all sound interesting. I'm particularly drawn to the Cole Haan Men's Grnd Plus Essex Wedgechukka Chukka Boot because of its rugged and stylish description. Can you tell me more about the materials used in these boots?
dialogue.agent:
The **"Cole Haan Men's Grnd Plus Essex Wedgechukka Chukka Boot"** is made of 100% leather with a rubber sole. The shaft measures approximately ankle-high from the arch. These boots are designed with a dress-casual platform that can be dressed up or down. The Grand.OS technology provides lightness, flexibility, comfortable cushioning, and breathability. The outsole is designed for improved traction.

Here are some customer reviews:
1. **Rating: 5.0**: "I love these shoes from the moment i started wearing them. Very comfortable from the start, the sole has a nice cushion which absorbs the feel of the sidewalk, pavement, cobblestone and gravel of my daily walking in the city. looks great with a nice pair of pants too. I think i need another pair in a 2nd color or another pair in low-top to wear with shorts."
2. **Rating: 4.0**: "These shoes are very comfortable and can be used not only for work but also casual wear as well. Only downside is if you get a stain on them, there is no removing it and it's very easy to see. Other than that though, if you can keep them clean, these are a great product for work or going out."
3. **Rating: 5.0**: "I’m very satisfied with the product and it was delivered as promised no surprise and will shop at the store again and recommend others as well"

Would you like to proceed with purchasing these boots, or do you have any other questions?
